_readme: Golden retrieval set for the parent-child (PDF) corpus. Labels point at parent_ids = '<source>#<section_idx>' exactly as parent_child_rag builds them from sections.json. type: factual = query uses doc vocabulary; paraphrase = same target as a factual item but reworded with synonyms (tests dense > lexical); negative = answer is NOT in the corpus, a good retriever should score low / a good generator should refuse. Grow this to 50+ before trusting small deltas. relevant_parent_ids may list more than one when several sections legitimately answer.
